upGrad Reports ₹2,000 Cr Gross Revenue and ₹123 Cr EBITDA for FY26

Online education platform upGrad announced it has crossed ₹2,000 crore in gross revenue for the fiscal year 2026. The company also reported an eight-fold increase in its Earnings Before Interest, Taxes, Depreciation, and Amortization (EBITDA), reaching ₹123 crore for the same period. These financial figures represent significant growth for the edtech firm.
